info.longName: Fidelity Enhanced Large Cap Core ETF

funds_data.description: The fund will normally invest at least 80% of assets in common stocks included in the S&P 500® Index, which is a market capitalization-weighted index of 500 common stocks chosen for market size, liquidity, and industry group representation to represent U.S. equity performance. The adviser will generally utilizing a research-driven approach identifying long-term drivers of stock returns that may include, but are not limited to, valuation, growth, quality, and other factors.
